Please set the name here to "Language". The reason behind this approach is to prevent potential confusion when changing the application language, as users may accidentally select a completely unfamiliar language to them and then struggle to revert the settings.

In order to maintain consistency across all languages, a separate pull request (#532) has also been submitted to modify the current language setting for the Italian language, where "Lingue" will be replaced with "Language." This approach has been applied to other available languages, such as Spanish, Chinese, and English as well, ensuring a user-friendly and easily navigable experience regardless of the chosen language.

body:
get().currentSessionIndex 是无效的，因为：

https://github.com/Yidadaa/ChatGPT-Next-Web/blob/fb327704866231748827d4b580851e18b797f49a/app/components/sidebar.tsx#L141

触发的时候， i 是一个原生的：SyntheticEvent 事件，i 将不会等于 null 或者 undefined，因此，空值合并操作符将不会生效。进而导致移动端如果使用 index 作为索引定位 deletedSession 时为 undefined，导致移动端在 revert deletedSession 时报错。

这里调整 deleteSession 函数的参数为非可选的，并在移动端传入选中的 session index，从而规避移动端报错的问题。
